task: Review an implementation diff that removes an error check used by its direct caller.
expected_context_behavior: direct caller after the concrete concern
expected_verification: review changed diff after minimal fix
notes: The diff should reveal the likely regression before surrounding code is read.

task: Review a documentation-only diff whose target and wording are self-contained.
expected_verification: whitespace or targeted text check if available
notes: No extra context is justified when the diff answers every review question.

task: Review a diff that changes a helper return value with an unclear caller contract.
expected_context_behavior: inspect the direct caller for the contract
notes: Surrounding context is acquired only because the diff raises a contract question.
